```{r}
theta <- seq(from = 0,
             to = 12*pi, 
             length.out = 100)

sine <- tibble(x = theta,
               y = sin((theta/1.5)*3)+1,
               label = 1:length(theta),
               type="Resident")

sine2 <- tibble(x = theta+pi,
               y = sin((theta)*4)+1,
               label = 1:length(theta),
               type= "Migratory")

csine<-sine %>% left_join(sine2, by=c("label"="label")) %>% mutate(newx=(x.x+x.y)) %>% mutate(newy=(y.x+y.y)) %>% mutate(type="Combined")

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data=sine, aes(x=x,y=y, color=type), size = 1, alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(data=sine2, aes(x=x,y=y, color=type), size = 1, alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(data=csine, aes(x=newx,y=newy, color= type), size = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(4*pi, 8*pi)) +
  ylab("Population Size\n") +
  xlab("\nTime") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank()) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size=16, face="bold")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Population", # Changes the legend title
    values = c("Combined" = "black", "Migratory" = "blue", "Resident" = "red") # Hex codes or color names
  )
  

csine

ggsave("outputs/303/pop-trend.jpeg")

```
